text:
Silver Price in 1971
Among 12 monthly observations available for 1971, the LBMA silver price fell 13.9% between 1971-01-29 ($1.59) and 1971-12-31 ($1.37). The highest sampled price was $1.69 in April and the lowest was $1.31 in October. The mean of these observations was $1.52. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
What happened in 1971:
President Nixon suspended the dollar's convertibility to gold, ending the Bretton Woods system and letting the gold price float freely.
